The 4½ Litre supercharged 'Blower' Bentley, championed by Sir Henry Birkin against W.O. Bentley's wishes, hit 125+ mph at Le Mans and Brooklands. Only 50 were built, but the Blower Bentleys became the most famous vintage racing Bentleys of all, symbols of heroic 1920s motorsport. Baseline facts: British racing car 1927-1931; 50 built by Bentley; supercharged 4.4L four..
